17 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

The stories

  • Rochdale holds poignant Remembrance Day services to honour fallen servicemen Rochdale
    Thousands gather across the borough to pay their respects during Remembrance Day services, acknowledging the sacrifices made by servicemen and women.
  • Remembrance Sunday: parades and services at eight war memorials across Rochdale borough Rochdale
    Times and routes for today's Remembrance Sunday parades in Rochdale, Heywood, Middleton, Littleborough, Milnrow, Castleton, Norden and Wardle.
  • Elsie Blundell MP attends Middleton Remembrance service as parliamentary wreaths laid across constituency Middleton
    Heywood and Middleton North MP Elsie Blundell attended Middleton's service, with wreaths laid on her behalf in Heywood, Castleton, Norden and at Rochdale Cenotaph.
  • Castleton Remembrance Sunday service draws big crowd but resident asks for a better speaker next year Castleton
    Crowds gathered on Castleton's village green for the Act of Remembrance, but one resident said the words could not be heard.
  • Middleton's Veterans' Walk: the poppy mural honouring the town's service men and women on Remembrance Sunday Middleton
    A wreath has been laid at Middleton's Veterans' Walk, the Middleton in Bloom mural of poppies, a Spitfire and the white cliffs of Dover.
  • Rochdale remembers fallen heroes at Remembrance Sunday service Rochdale
    The Remembrance Sunday parade and service took place in Rochdale, honouring those who served and sacrificed for their country.
  • How many Rochdale servicemen died in the world wars and since? The records give no single answer Rochdale
    Between 2,000 and 3,000 Rochdale men are thought to have died in the First World War. No published record gives a borough total for the Second World War or later conflicts.
  • Free job-search, CV and money advice at Middleton Library today Middleton
    Middleton Library is hosting a free work and skills hub on Monday 9 November, with help for job applications, interviews and managing budgets.
  • Free Heywood Library friendship group offers a place to meet people this Thursday Heywood
    A free drop-in friendship group at Heywood Library on Thursday 12 November is open to adults, with no advance booking required.
  • Rochdale veterans breakfast club receives £500 donation from housebuilders Rochdale
    The donation from Barratt and David Wilson Homes will help cover the club's running costs ahead of Remembrance Day.
  • Woman dies at Tesco in Rochdale after emergency services called Rochdale
    A woman in her 50s has died following an incident at a Tesco store on Silk Street, Rochdale, on Saturday afternoon.
  • Rochdale South Township Committee meets on Wednesday: when and where Rochdale
    Rochdale South Township Committee is scheduled to meet at Number One Riverside on Wednesday 11 November. Here is how residents can check the agenda.

Weather: Partly cloudy 9°C in Rochdale today.

body:
17 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

The stories:

Rochdale holds poignant Remembrance Day services to honour fallen servicemen (Rochdale). Thousands gather across the borough to pay their respects during Remembrance Day services, acknowledging the sacrifices made by servicemen and women.

Remembrance Sunday: parades and services at eight war memorials across Rochdale borough (Rochdale). Times and routes for today's Remembrance Sunday parades in Rochdale, Heywood, Middleton, Littleborough, Milnrow, Castleton, Norden and Wardle.

Elsie Blundell MP attends Middleton Remembrance service as parliamentary wreaths laid across constituency (Middleton). Heywood and Middleton North MP Elsie Blundell attended Middleton's service, with wreaths laid on her behalf in Heywood, Castleton, Norden and at Rochdale Cenotaph.

Castleton Remembrance Sunday service draws big crowd but resident asks for a better speaker next year (Castleton). Crowds gathered on Castleton's village green for the Act of Remembrance, but one resident said the words could not be heard.

Middleton's Veterans' Walk: the poppy mural honouring the town's service men and women on Remembrance Sunday (Middleton). A wreath has been laid at Middleton's Veterans' Walk, the Middleton in Bloom mural of poppies, a Spitfire and the white cliffs of Dover.

Rochdale remembers fallen heroes at Remembrance Sunday service (Rochdale). The Remembrance Sunday parade and service took place in Rochdale, honouring those who served and sacrificed for their country.

How many Rochdale servicemen died in the world wars and since? The records give no single answer (Rochdale). Between 2,000 and 3,000 Rochdale men are thought to have died in the First World War. No published record gives a borough total for the Second World War or later conflicts.

Free job-search, CV and money advice at Middleton Library today (Middleton). Middleton Library is hosting a free work and skills hub on Monday 9 November, with help for job applications, interviews and managing budgets.

Free Heywood Library friendship group offers a place to meet people this Thursday (Heywood). A free drop-in friendship group at Heywood Library on Thursday 12 November is open to adults, with no advance booking required.

Rochdale veterans breakfast club receives £500 donation from housebuilders (Rochdale). The donation from Barratt and David Wilson Homes will help cover the club's running costs ahead of Remembrance Day.

Woman dies at Tesco in Rochdale after emergency services called (Rochdale). A woman in her 50s has died following an incident at a Tesco store on Silk Street, Rochdale, on Saturday afternoon.

Rochdale South Township Committee meets on Wednesday: when and where (Rochdale). Rochdale South Township Committee is scheduled to meet at Number One Riverside on Wednesday 11 November. Here is how residents can check the agenda.

Weather: Partly cloudy 9°C in Rochdale today.

The Morning Briefing is published every day at 9am. Got a story? Tell the newsdesk.
